title: Savage, Warrior and Elizabeth: defeat and reunion
summary: A career-threatening match strips Savage of his position, but reunites him with Elizabeth. Their on-screen reconciliation leads to a SummerSlam wedding.

chapters.title: Warrior wins the retirement match
chapters.context: Savage loses the match carrying the retirement stipulation.

chapters.title: Savage and Elizabeth’s on-screen wedding
chapters.result: Savage and Elizabeth celebrate the Match Made in Heaven.
chapters.context: This is a televised storyline wedding, separate from their real-life marriage.
